points.text: The rank of the Shi'a and the value of individuals are determined by their conscious knowledge and comprehension of narrations rather than mere transmission.
Comprehension of a single narration is superior to merely narrating a thousand without understanding.
A true knowledgeable person (faqih) must be aware of the various indications and meanings within the Imams' speech.
Allah judges people in this world according to the amount of intellect and conscious knowledge granted to them.
